start_here: Say to your AI: "Which treg team does my connection pay from? I need the team number to read the balance." It runs tool:read-my-treg-team with {}.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it asks treg who your held token is and writes nothing.
instructions: 1. Connect treg once with its API key; the connection seals the key as treg-api-key.
2. Say to your AI: "Which treg team does my connection pay from?". It calls tools:run with tool tool:read-my-treg-team and an empty input.
3. Read org_id in the answer: that is the team_id tool:read-my-treg-balance takes.
4. Nothing is spent and the token is never shown.
